**In one line**: Media company Axios is partnering with OpenAI to bring AI into local journalism.

### Key points
- Axios and OpenAI reportedly formed a partnership to integrate AI into local news reporting and production.
- The collaboration appears focused on supporting reporting and improving production efficiency for resource-strapped local newsrooms.
- It continues a recent trend of major AI firms and news publishers teaming up over content and technology.

### Why it matters
Local news outlets have shrunk amid declining ad and subscription revenue. The open questions are whether AI-assisted reporting and editing can improve local journalism's sustainability, and how the partners will handle copyright and trust concerns.
